description: This source file defines functions to facilitate the loading and configuration of test patterns and settings for an IRC extension in a Vitest testing environment. It imports external utilities and creates a default test configuration based on environment variables and predefined roots.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads inclusion patterns from environment variables or defaults to a set of predefined test root directories.

methods.name: export function createExtensionIrcVitestConfig( createExtensionIrcVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a scoped Vitest configuration tailored for the IRC extension, including environment-specific patterns and setup files.
